title: Friendship Village Campground

services.name: Aspen Cabins
services.desc: Spacious and comfortable cabin that sleeps up to 8 guests. Features two bedrooms with queen beds and two queen sleeper sofas, plus a full bathroom and a relaxing sunroom. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen with a full-size refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, toaster, and all dishes and cookware. A washer and dryer are also included for added convenience. Stay comfortable with AC & heat and unwind with two cable TVs. Outside, enjoy a picnic table and fire ring-perfect for relaxing evenings.
